note: Only behavior the official runner does not cover on this profile. Each residual names its consumer and the test that asserts it. This is not a matrix engine: every row is a recorded pair or fault.

residuals.title: Client-visible unknown-tool message depends on the client SDK line
residuals.derivedFrom: McpError constructor in sdk 1.32.2 dist/esm/types.js and ProtocolError constructor in client 2.4.0; confirmed live by the consumer test on a Cursor VM.
residuals.whyNotRunner: The official runner drives the server with its own SDK client and has no unknown-tool scenario for a non-fixture tool name.

residuals.title: 2026-07-28 refusal uses JSON-RPC -32000, not the 2026-07-28 UnsupportedProtocolVersion code -32022
residuals.specNote: 2026-07-28 keeps -32000 to -32019 implementation-defined and renumbers UnsupportedProtocolVersion to -32022. The free profile does not claim 2026-07-28, so this is classified unsupported, not a defect.
residuals.whyNotRunner: The runner's 2026-07-28 leg stops at server/discover on this profile and reports the whole leg as failing; it does not separate a declared refusal from a defect.

residuals.title: Tasks capability declared per request still yields a synchronous CallToolResult on 2025-11-25
residuals.whyNotRunner: The runner's tasks-* scenarios are 2026-07-28 extension scenarios, not scored, and unsupported on this profile, so the 2025-11-25 synchronous lock is otherwise uncovered.
